Actual saved Gym paths. Rows: direction/width priority; columns: upper-narrow, upper-wide, lower-narrow, lower-wide. Thin blue: all after episodes; bold blue: learned20 episode0; orange: oracle episode0; gray: before learned20 episode0 if supplied, otherwise raw base. Counts require task success AND target midpoint mode. New features and synthetic labels are mode-aligned; before uses the old continuous objective. This visual comparison concerns task/mode outcomes, not a like-for-like utility value. No trajectory morphing or cherry-picked episodes. See mode_summary.json.
